units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: It's only when the people around me start staring that I realize that I'm starting to sparkle.
units.displayText: It's only when the people around me start staring that I realize that I'm starting to sparkle.

spans.text: It's only when the people around me start staring that I realize that I'm starting to sparkle.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, the floor-to-ceiling display window in the store beside me begins to deform and ripple.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, the floor-to-ceiling display window in the store beside me begins to deform and ripple.

spans.text: Meanwhile, the floor-to-ceiling display window in the store beside me begins to deform and ripple.

units.rawText: Whew— Looks like the story's over.
units.displayText: Whew— Looks like the story's over.

spans.text: Whew— Looks like the story's over.

units.rawText: Story? What story? Professor, are you leaving?
units.displayText: Story? What story? Professor, are you leaving?

spans.text: Story? What story? Professor, are you leaving?

units.rawText: Yup. It's time.
units.displayText: Yup. It's time.

spans.text: Yup. It's time.

units.rawText: Professor... Will you come back?
units.displayText: Professor... Will you come back?

spans.text: Professor... Will you come back?

units.rawText: Perhaps... Or perhaps, you might be the ones visiting me, no?
units.displayText: Perhaps... Or perhaps, you might be the ones visiting me, no?

spans.text: Perhaps... Or perhaps, you might be the ones visiting me, no?

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: Is your journey at an end?
units.displayText: Is your journey at an end?

spans.text: Is your journey at an end?

units.rawText: At some point, Nanaka and Li'l Kuro have made their way through the crowd and have arrived in front of me.
units.displayText: At some point, Nanaka and Li'l Kuro have made their way through the crowd and have arrived in front of me.

spans.text: At some point, Nanaka and Li'l Kuro have made their way through the crowd and have arrived in front of me.

units.rawText: Just so you know! I'm still annoyed with you for beating up all my penlight troopers!
units.displayText: Just so you know! I'm still annoyed with you for beating up all my penlight troopers!

spans.text: Just so you know! I'm still annoyed with you for beating up all my penlight troopers!

units.rawText: But for Nanaka's sake, if anyone tries to bully you, I'll turn into the evil dragon and scare them to death!
units.displayText: But for Nanaka's sake, if anyone tries to bully you, I'll turn into the evil dragon and scare them to death!

spans.text: But for Nanaka's sake, if anyone tries to bully you, I'll turn into the evil dragon and scare them to death!

units.rawText: Li'l Kuro, you can't turn into the dragon any more.
units.displayText: Li'l Kuro, you can't turn into the dragon any more.

spans.text: Li'l Kuro, you can't turn into the dragon any more.

units.rawText: Oh yeah... That's right... Then what should I do...
units.displayText: Oh yeah... That's right... Then what should I do...

spans.text: Oh yeah... That's right... Then what should I do...

units.rawText: No... No way, why now, all of a sudden!?
units.displayText: No... No way, why now, all of a sudden!?

spans.text: No... No way, why now, all of a sudden!?

units.rawText: Croquette, who has been looking tired all this time, suddenly starts to panic.
units.displayText: Croquette, who has been looking tired all this time, suddenly starts to panic.

spans.text: Croquette, who has been looking tired all this time, suddenly starts to panic.
(Comfort Croquette.)
(Tease Croquette.)

units.rawText: I bend down and just like before, I ruffle Croquette's hair.
units.displayText: I bend down and just like before, I ruffle Croquette's hair.

spans.text: I bend down and just like before, I ruffle Croquette's hair.

units.rawText: All stories have to come to an end. We'll meet again in the future.
units.displayText: All stories have to come to an end. We'll meet again in the future.

spans.text: All stories have to come to an end. We'll meet again in the future.

units.rawText: Really? Then why do I feel like you're tricking me?
units.displayText: Really? Then why do I feel like you're tricking me?

spans.text: Really? Then why do I feel like you're tricking me?

units.rawText: Hehe, then how about we make a pinky promise?
units.displayText: Hehe, then how about we make a pinky promise?

spans.text: Hehe, then how about we make a pinky promise?

units.rawText: ...You're such a child.
units.displayText: ...You're such a child.

spans.text: ...You're such a child.

units.rawText: Also, the person who offers the promise never keeps it.
units.displayText: Also, the person who offers the promise never keeps it.

spans.text: Also, the person who offers the promise never keeps it.

units.rawText: That's only for other people, not me. Come, may whoever tells a lie swallow a thousand needles.
units.displayText: That's only for other people, not me. Come, may whoever tells a lie swallow a thousand needles.

spans.text: That's only for other people, not me. Come, may whoever tells a lie swallow a thousand needles.

units.rawText: ...May whoever tells a lie swallow a thousand needles.
units.displayText: ...May whoever tells a lie swallow a thousand needles.

spans.text: ...May whoever tells a lie swallow a thousand needles.

units.rawText: Aw, do you miss me so much?
units.displayText: Aw, do you miss me so much?

spans.text: Aw, do you miss me so much?

units.rawText: My response was intended to be purely rhetorical, but to my surprise Croquette nods vigorously.
units.displayText: My response was intended to be purely rhetorical, but to my surprise Croquette nods vigorously.

spans.text: My response was intended to be purely rhetorical, but to my surprise Croquette nods vigorously.

units.rawText: You... Can't you stay for just a little longer?
units.displayText: You... Can't you stay for just a little longer?

spans.text: You... Can't you stay for just a little longer?

units.rawText: Hehe, alright! You're a big hero after all, Croquette.
units.displayText: Hehe, alright! You're a big hero after all, Croquette.

spans.text: Hehe, alright! You're a big hero after all, Croquette.

units.rawText: In future, when you think of me, just look up at the sky.
units.displayText: In future, when you think of me, just look up at the sky.

spans.text: In future, when you think of me, just look up at the sky.

units.rawText: Up at the sky?
units.displayText: Up at the sky?

spans.text: Up at the sky?

units.rawText: Who knows, I might end up falling out of it again.
units.displayText: Who knows, I might end up falling out of it again.

spans.text: Who knows, I might end up falling out of it again.

units.rawText: Pfft— Hahaha.
units.displayText: Pfft— Hahaha.

spans.text: Pfft— Hahaha.

units.rawText: Alright then, I'll be off now.
units.displayText: Alright then, I'll be off now.

spans.text: Alright then, I'll be off now.

units.rawText: Croquette is still clinging to my sleeve. Her little fingers tense up several times before she finally lets go.
units.displayText: Croquette is still clinging to my sleeve. Her little fingers tense up several times before she finally lets go.

spans.text: Croquette is still clinging to my sleeve. Her little fingers tense up several times before she finally lets go.

units.rawText: In that case... Goodbye, Professor. Make sure you take care on the way home so you don't fall into a pile of snow again.
units.displayText: In that case... Goodbye, Professor. Make sure you take care on the way home so you don't fall into a pile of snow again.

spans.text: In that case... Goodbye, Professor. Make sure you take care on the way home so you don't fall into a pile of snow again.

units.rawText: If you get stuck, just shout for me. I'll fly Laputa over to save you!
units.displayText: If you get stuck, just shout for me. I'll fly Laputa over to save you!

spans.text: If you get stuck, just shout for me. I'll fly Laputa over to save you!

units.rawText: Wait! Professor, what about me?
units.displayText: Wait! Professor, what about me?

spans.text: Wait! Professor, what about me?

units.rawText: Chelsea suddenly grabs my wrist.
units.displayText: Chelsea suddenly grabs my wrist.

spans.text: Chelsea suddenly grabs my wrist.

units.rawText: We've fought side by side for so long, isn't there something you ought to be doing before you leave?
units.displayText: We've fought side by side for so long, isn't there something you ought to be doing before you leave?

spans.text: We've fought side by side for so long, isn't there something you ought to be doing before you leave?
(Poke fun at Chelsea.)
(Play along with Chelsea.)

units.rawText: Huh? Does someone of your stature need anything from me, Your Highness?
units.displayText: Huh? Does someone of your stature need anything from me, Your Highness?

spans.text: Huh? Does someone of your stature need anything from me, Your Highness?

units.rawText: Hehe, of course. You can't show favoritism to people, even though I haven't spent as long with you as Croquette has...
units.displayText: Hehe, of course. You can't show favoritism to people, even though I haven't spent as long with you as Croquette has...

spans.text: Hehe, of course. You can't show favoritism to people, even though I haven't spent as long with you as Croquette has...

units.rawText: But that doesn't mean you shouldn't do something!
units.displayText: But that doesn't mean you shouldn't do something!

spans.text: But that doesn't mean you shouldn't do something!

units.rawText: Alright, alright, how about this...
units.displayText: Alright, alright, how about this...

spans.text: Alright, alright, how about this...

units.rawText: I bend down and pick up Chelsea's hand before lightly kissing its back.
units.displayText: I bend down and pick up Chelsea's hand before lightly kissing its back.

spans.text: I bend down and pick up Chelsea's hand before lightly kissing its back.

units.rawText: My dear princess, the journey is at an end and the traveler must now return home.
units.displayText: My dear princess, the journey is at an end and the traveler must now return home.

spans.text: My dear princess, the journey is at an end and the traveler must now return home.

units.rawText: Eep...!
units.displayText: Eep...!

spans.text: Eep...!

units.rawText: Al... Alright, then! Have... Have a good trip!
units.displayText: Al... Alright, then! Have... Have a good trip!

spans.text: Al... Alright, then! Have... Have a good trip!

units.rawText: <size=28>Don't forget the Princess Principles which I taught you, Chelsea.</size>
units.displayText: Don't forget the Princess Principles which I taught you, Chelsea.

spans.text: Don't forget the Princess Principles which I taught you, Chelsea.

units.rawText: Ah... Ah! May your return be smooth, my knight!
units.displayText: Ah... Ah! May your return be smooth, my knight!

spans.text: Ah... Ah! May your return be smooth, my knight!

units.rawText: Of course. How could I forget?
units.displayText: Of course. How could I forget?

spans.text: Of course. How could I forget?

units.rawText: I smile, and then bow to Chelsea like the mini-robot general.
units.displayText: I smile, and then bow to Chelsea like the mini-robot general.

spans.text: I smile, and then bow to Chelsea like the mini-robot general.

units.rawText: Your Highness, Private <cmdr> requests permission to return home.
units.displayText: Your Highness, Private {교수} requests permission to return home.

spans.text: Your Highness, Private
requests permission to return home.

units.rawText: Ahem. Permission granted! Go then, my soldier. You have permission to leave.
units.displayText: Ahem. Permission granted! Go then, my soldier. You have permission to leave.

spans.text: Ahem. Permission granted! Go then, my soldier. You have permission to leave.

units.rawText: After the smiles and the laughter die down, I take a step back and regard the scene before me.
units.displayText: After the smiles and the laughter die down, I take a step back and regard the scene before me.

spans.text: After the smiles and the laughter die down, I take a step back and regard the scene before me.

units.rawText: Chelsea is laughing, Croquette looks earnest, yet reluctant to let me go, Nanaka is watching me from a distance with a gentle look on her face, while Li'l Kuro is messing around...
units.displayText: Chelsea is laughing, Croquette looks earnest, yet reluctant to let me go, Nanaka is watching me from a distance with a gentle look on her face, while Li'l Kuro is messing around...

spans.text: Chelsea is laughing, Croquette looks earnest, yet reluctant to let me go, Nanaka is watching me from a distance with a gentle look on her face, while Li'l Kuro is messing around...

units.rawText: At last, this bizarre journey has come to a satisfying conclusion.
units.displayText: At last, this bizarre journey has come to a satisfying conclusion.

spans.text: At last, this bizarre journey has come to a satisfying conclusion.

units.rawText: May we meet again, everyone.
units.displayText: May we meet again, everyone.

spans.text: May we meet again, everyone.

units.rawText: Professor, I'll build the strongest Metal Suit and look you up!
units.displayText: Professor, I'll build the strongest Metal Suit and look you up!

spans.text: Professor, I'll build the strongest Metal Suit and look you up!

units.rawText: Remember to come back when your princess is in trouble!
units.displayText: Remember to come back when your princess is in trouble!

spans.text: Remember to come back when your princess is in trouble!

units.rawText: Thank you for your help. Safe journeys.
units.displayText: Thank you for your help. Safe journeys.

spans.text: Thank you for your help. Safe journeys.

units.rawText: Tsk. Bye bye, then.
units.displayText: Tsk. Bye bye, then.

spans.text: Tsk. Bye bye, then.

units.rawText: The well-wishes slowly fill the air, and then they transform into a wave of applause.
units.displayText: The well-wishes slowly fill the air, and then they transform into a wave of applause.

spans.text: The well-wishes slowly fill the air, and then they transform into a wave of applause.

units.rawText: As I enter the doorway of light before me, I hear Croquette yelling at the top of her voice, just before I fully pass through it.
units.displayText: As I enter the doorway of light before me, I hear Croquette yelling at the top of her voice, just before I fully pass through it.

spans.text: As I enter the doorway of light before me, I hear Croquette yelling at the top of her voice, just before I fully pass through it.

units.rawText: Goodbye, Professor!
units.displayText: Goodbye, Professor!

spans.text: Goodbye, Professor!

units.rawText: <size=60>I HOPE WE MEET AGAIN!</size>
units.displayText: I HOPE WE MEET AGAIN!
